entry.author: Whaikaha — Ministry of Disabled People
entry.summary:
It is time to refresh the New Zealand Disability Strategy. We are planning to do broad consultation later in the year. For now, we are setting up Working Groups to help with the refresh. 

We are seeking Expressions of Interest from disabled people, Deaf, tāngata whaikaha Māori, whānau hauā, Turi Māori, Pacific people, and families to be selected to be part of paid Working Groups* that will help to shape the New Zealand Disability Strategy.

Expressions of interest are open now and close on 6 March 2025.
For more information visit our website: https://bit.ly/3Qtq0Dv

*Please note, the details of the Working Groups and key outcome areas are due to be considered by Cabinet in March 2025.
